req.title: Reject invalid date-of-birth format
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when dateOfBirth cannot be parsed as ISO-8601 date.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should reject invalid date-of-birth formats with an HTTP 422 response. We will test this by providing valid, invalid, and boundary date formats to ensure the system behaves as expected.

tests.name: test_valid_date_of_birth_format
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a valid ISO-8601 date format in the dateOfBirth field.
expected: The response contains the created player data.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

valid_player_data = {
    "firstName": "John",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Forward"
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=valid_player_data)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert "id" in response.json()

tests.name: test_invalid_date_of_birth_format
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with an invalid date format in the dateOfBirth field.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating unprocessable entity.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

invalid_player_data = {
    "firstName": "Jane",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "dateOfBirth": "01-01-1990",
    "squadNumber": 11,
    "position": "Midfielder"
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=invalid_player_data)
assert response.status_code == 422
assert response.json() == {"detail": "Unprocessable Entity - request body validation failed"}

tests.name: test_boundary_date_of_birth_format
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a boundary date format in the dateOfBirth field.
expected: The response contains the created player data.
tests.executable:
